description: Install ai-product directly from its own repository. For the whole AI Team use the HPAIF/ai-team catalog.

plugins.name: ai-product
plugins.description: AI Team in-house product manager for founders: synthesises customer research into jobs-to-be-done and opportunity solution trees, frames problems, writes specs and Shape Up pitches, prioritises the roadmap (RICE, Now/Next/Later), defines North Star and input metrics, and keeps an evidence-linked feedback log in a private workspace. Evidence over opinion; never invents customers, quotes or numbers; the founder decides.
